snippet.title: NINJA GAIDEN 4 - Official Release Date Trailer | Xbox Games Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
WHERE SHADOWS FALL, LEGENDS RISE. 

The definitive ninja action-adventure franchise returns with NINJA GAIDEN 4! Embark on a cutting-edge adventure where legacy meets innovation in a high-octane blend of style and no-holds-barred combat. 

Pre-order now to receive the Dark Dragon Descendant Yakumo Skin at launch: https://www.xbox.com/games/ninja-gaiden-4

Discover the endless adventures you can unlock with Xbox Series X|S. Shop Now: https://www.xbox.com/consoles
